scripts.dev:local: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n WEB,API,WORKER -c blue,magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @manzhushaka/web dev" "pnpm --filter @manzhushaka/api start:dev" "pnpm --filter @manzhushaka/worker dev"
scripts.dev:prod-like: pnpm run build && pnpm run start:prod
scripts.start:prod: concurrently -k -n WEB,API,WORKER -c blue,magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @manzhushaka/web start" "pnpm --filter @manzhushaka/api start" "pnpm --filter @manzhushaka/worker start"
